Job Post: Security-Focused Messaging App Developer

Project: Build the security foundation for an end-to-end encrypted messaging app (iOS + Android + backend).

Scope 5 core features:

1. App Lock biometric/PIN independent of device lock, auto-lock timer, app-switcher blur, brute-force protection, on by default.
2. One-Time Provisioning Links single-use, short-lived, device-bound signup/enrollment tokens. No passwords.

Phase 2 (optional, later): FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware key enrollment, ephemeral "no local history" mode.

Must have experience with:
- Signal Protocol / Double Ratchet or similar E2EE
- iOS Keychain / Secure Enclave, Android Keystore / BiometricPrompt
- Push infrastructure (APNs/FCM), token revocation, session/auth backend
- WebAuthn/FIDO2 (a plus)

Deliverables: working implementation, test coverage, documentation, and support through a third-party security review.

To apply, please include:
- Relevant secure messaging / cryptography projects you've shipped
- Your platform coverage (iOS / Android / backend or full stack)
- Estimated timeline and cost per phase
- Availability
